text:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — prod-global /v1/generate p95 spike detected. p50 up ~40ms, p95 jumped from 160ms -> 720ms. Error-rate +1.6x. Auto-pager activated.

alex: oncall ack. Triage roles: @mira traces/RCA, @sam infra/hosts, @derek decisioning for kernel changes, @jen customer comms. Starting quick recon.

mira: pulling a span diff now. Model-infer span median increased ~180ms, tail much larger. Kernel scheduling and blk paths are top-of-stack in many slow traces (sched_wakeup, schedule, blk_mq_run_hw_queues). Time window: 15:04:20 - 15:12:10 UTC.

sam: host-side: several nodes in nvmepool-5 show sustained iowait and runqueue length spikes. CPU steal low, but runqueue (r) spikes to 6-8. No app deploys flagged.

jen: CS heartbeat: two premium customers reported interactive UI stalls ~15:06. About 34 impacted sessions. Sending initial TY note.

mira: grabbing perf counters on noisy host nvme-5c: `perf stat -e cpu-clock,context-switches,cpu-migrations,cycles,instructions -a sleep 8` returned:

```
Performance counter stats for 'system wide':
     3,456,789,012 cycles
     2,987,654,321 instructions
           9,876 context-switches
           1,234 cpu-migrations
       8.002 seconds time elapsed
```

mira: also ran `perf top -p <infer-pid>` — top symbols show `schedule`, `hrtimer_nanosleep`, `__blk_mq_run_hw_queues` and a few `nvme` driver functions.

sam: iostat snapshot from nvme-5c:
```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  rrqm/s wrqm/s  %util
nvme0n1        180.00  680.00  7200.0 28000.0   0.00   0.00  99.85
```
vmstat shows `r` column spikes and `wa` ~18-25% during window.

mira: dmesg tail from the host includes repeated lines:
```
[15:06:08] nvme nvme0: I/O 0xabcde failed, status 0x2
[15:06:09] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 345678
[15:06:10] nvme nvme0: controller reset
```

alex: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce inference batch window (BATCH_MS 100->40) 2) route 10% of traffic to smaller-model fallback (generate-smol) 3) cordon top noisy hosts for replacement. Applying 1 and 2 now.

sam: routing rule applied: 10% -> generate-smol at 3160005566. Batch config rolled to workers.

incident-bot: Config change recorded at 3160005566 by sam.

mira: tracing-bot: uploaded traces and side-by-side comparison for patched vs unpatched hosts — link: https://traces.internal/3160005555/compare. Annotated kernel-heavy spans.

tracing-bot: Trace ingestion complete. Added heatmap and span P50/P95 delta annotations.

sam: checking kernel/patch inventory: automated roll from release engineering pushed kernel package linux-6.5.2-blkq to a subset (~38%) of nvmepool-5 last night (roll id: roll-2026-03-13-6.5.2). Flagging hosts.

mira: correlation: hosts with linux-6.5.2-blkq show +170-250ms on tail vs unpatched. Evidence accumulating for kernel interaction.

alex: hypothesis tracker (live):
- H1 (PRIORITY): the linux-6.5.2-blkq backport changed blk-mq scheduling/latency accounting, increasing queue depth temporal behavior -> NVMe controller retries -> inference tail increase.
- H2: NVMe firmware sensitivity to io pattern triggered controller resets when combined with blk-mq tweak.
- H3: Workload change (larger batches after last config push) increased burstiness, exposing a pre-existing kernel/pathology.

mira: action: collecting ftrace for blk_mq and schedule group, and will attach `perf record` + `perf script`. Also pulling the exact kernel git diff for the backport commit.

sam: cordoning nvme-5c and nvme-5d now. Initiating replacement images without the backport on replacement nodes. ETA ~11m per node.

jen: customer update: "We've enacted partial mitigations (traffic diversion, worker config changes). We're actively investigating and will provide updates every 30 minutes." Sent to affected CSMs.

ops-bot: Logged action: H1 prioritized and assigned to mira/sam/derek for repro + rollback plan.

mira: small reproducible test: applied linux-6.5.2-blkq to staging-nvme-1 and replayed synthetic batch-heavy traffic. Observed blk_mq requeue and additional schedule stalls; p95 uplift matches production. Repro artifact uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/3160005555/repro.tar.gz

derek: if repro holds, prepare rollback plan: canary rollback on 4 hosts in nvmepool-5, observe 20m; if metrics return to baseline, expand rollback. Need infra-eng approval and change advisory.

alex: agree. derek, please prepare the play and list the exact hosts for canary. Keep canary traffic minimal and verify with traces + iostat checks.

sam: canary hosts prepared: nvme-canary-1..4. I'll schedule rollback at 15:35 UTC pending derek sign-off.

tracing-bot: added perf + ftrace bundles to incident ticket and annotated spans where `blk_mq_run_hw_queues` time > 50ms.

mira: uploading dmesg and nvme logs to incident bucket. Excerpt of driver error pattern:
```
[15:06:08] nvme0: timeout waiting for completion
[15:06:09] nvme0n1: abort handled id=0x12f4
[15:06:09] blk_mq: __blk_mq_sched_requeue_slow
```

sam: canary rollback initiated at 3160005689. Rolling kernel to linux-6.4.9 on canary hosts.

incident-bot: change recorded: kernel rollback canary started by sam at 3160005689.

mira: live check: canary hosts show immediate reduction in blk_mq wait and fewer nvme controller logs. Early canary p95 ~140ms vs patched hosts ~580ms. Encouraging.

derek: ACK handoff — I will own expanding rollback if canary meets verification. Post-checklist: monitor p95, iowait, qlen, and controller logs for 20 minutes.

alex: I'm handing incident lead to derek at 16:00 UTC. I'll remain available for customer follow-ups.

jen: pre-change notice sent to customers 5 minutes before canary. CS ticket numbers: CS-5180, CS-5181 opened.

ops-bot: Action items pinned:
- [IN-PROGRESS] mira: full perf/ftrace + diff and commit diff analysis
- [IN-PROGRESS] sam: host cordon/replace + canary rollback
- [IN-PROGRESS] derek: run canary verification and coordinate expansion
- [IN-PROGRESS] jen: customer comms
- [TODO] alex: postmortem owner & timeline compilation

tracing-bot: final trace update: post-canary traces show P95 reduction on canary hosts to baseline. Annotated for PM review.

sam: canary verification complete: canary p95 stable at baseline for 22 minutes. Proceeding with phased rollback across remaining patched hosts in nvmepool-5.

incident-bot: metrics update: cluster p95 down from 720ms -> 260ms after phased rollback and host replacements.

mira: interim RCA summary: likely root cause is interaction between linux-6.5.2-blkq backport and our NVMe IO pattern causing blk-mq scheduling requeues and controller stress -> elevated inference latency. Repro confirmed in staging and fixed via rollback.

derek: rolling full rollback to remaining patched hosts now per plan. Will post completion ETA.

jen: drafting customer resolution note and will send once rollback completes and cluster stable.

alex: postmortem owner: alex. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow. Please add all artifacts to INC-3160005555: traces, perf, iostat, dmesg, rollout lists, rollback playbook.

mira: uploading all artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/3160005555/ and linking in ticket. Tagging H1 as "confirmed candidate" pending final review.

sam: monitoring cluster. If p95 > 500ms, re-page.

customer-success: will prepare customer-facing summary and coordinate with CSMs after final status.

alex: thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread only. Good job on fast repro and safe rollback. :thumbsup:
